## Guidethrough

<p>
|       The [**Focus Survey**]('https://www.bcb.gov.br/publicacoes/focus') is an important source of market expectations about Brazilian macroeconomic variables. The Central Bank of Brazil publishes a weekly report summarizing the expectations of financial institutions and analysts regarding the country's main economic indicators.
|       This library allows researchers to access daily data on expectation for macroeconomic variables such as price indexes and nominal interest rates across different forecast horizons.
|       Further details on how to extract the data are available in the following:

|       Readme - [English Tutorial](notes/tutorial_en.md)
|       Leiame - [Tutorial em Português](notes/tutorial_pt.md)
</p>
